mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.visit_date AS date, b.time_slot AS timeSlot, d.real_name AS realName, s.name AS deptName, d.fee, b.status, /* 判断是否已评价 */ (CASE WHEN e.id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS isEvaluated, e.rate, e.comment FROM sys_appointment b LEFT JOIN sys_doctor d ON b.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept s ON d.dept_id = s.id LEFT JOIN sys_evaluation e ON b.id = e.appointment_id WHERE b.patient_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.visit_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_appointment SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{bookingId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_evaluation (appointment_id , rate, comment, create_time) VALUES (#{appointmentId}, #{rate}, #{comment}, NOW())
